title: SRTM 1 arc-second elevation (SRTMGL1 v003)
fetched: tiles N10E079; resampled (bilinear) to the 30 m analysis grid; slope by Horn's 3x3 method on a ~150 m smoothed surface, plus a plane fit per field
credit: NASA JPL (2013). NASA Shuttle Radar Topography Mission Global 1 arc second. NASA EOSDIS Land Processes DAAC.
access: LP DAAC cloud archive (data.lpdaac.earthdatacloud.nasa.gov), Earthdata bearer token
message: elevation 28-34 m, field tilt 0.1-2.5 % (plane fit; raw-pixel slope reads 2.6 % because of radar noise); sanity passed
notes: Radar elevation has a few metres of vertical noise: taken pixel by pixel it reads as 2-4 % slope on flat ground. The app uses each field's overall tilt (plane fit), which averages that noise out. The survey predates any land levelling done since 2000.
